annotations.text:
A · Dark control-room
For: readable from 2 m while you stand at the shelves — huge condensed type, one green state colour, mono data. Scan-first.
Trade-off: Library and Settings feel like a console, not a Mac app.

B · Native macOS
For: feels like Music/Photos — sidebar, segmented tabs, standard controls; Library will be the strongest here.
Trade-off: the match card is smaller and lighter — hardest to read at distance.

C · Editorial record-sleeve
For: catalogue-card feel — serif titles, paper tones, each record presented as an entry.
Trade-off: most character, least glanceable; small caps labels need you close to the screen.

Same screen in all three: Scan window, auto mode, a 7" just matched, app now asking for the B-side. Pick a direction (or mix: e.g. A for Scan, B for Library) and I build the full set — Scan × 7 states, Library, Review queue, Settings.
